segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You grab the brass mistletoe off the workbench and thrust it high above your head!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instantly, the three soldiers freeze mid-stride. Their wooden jaws snap open, their glass eyes dilating in sheer panic.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the lead soldier chokes out with a mechanical shudder.

segments.speaker: soldier
segments.text: MISTLETOE DETECTED OVERHEAD! MILITARY HOSTILITIES SUSPENDED! INITIATE MANDATORY FESTIVE COURTESY!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Compelled by ancient holiday law, the soldiers drop their wooden shock-staves. The three giant wooden sentries turn to each other, bow stiffly at the waist, and begin exchanging absurdly polite holiday compliments:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: YOU LOOK EXCEPTIONALLY RADIANT THIS AFTERNOON, SERGEANT CRACKER!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: NO, SERGEANT, YOUR GOLD BUTTONS ARE BY FAR THE SUPERIOR ADORNMENT!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: While the soldiers are locked in an endless loop of frantic, aggressive hugging and bowing, you grab Pip’s paw and sprint past them!
